fileNodes.name: 001_fix_conversations_schema.sql
fileNodes.summary: Idempotent Postgres migration (wrapped in a transaction) that fixes the conversations table schema: widens user_id to VARCHAR(128) and drops its users FK so anonymous/CLI string IDs stop breaking inserts, adds a tenant_id column defaulting to 'default', replaces the globally-unique thread_id constraint with a composite (tenant_id, thread_id) unique index to prevent cross-tenant collisions, and adds tenant-scoped lookup indexes for list queries.

fileNodes.name: conversations
fileNodes.summary: The conversations table targeted by this migration — stores per-thread conversation state. This migration relaxes its user_id column to accept non-UUID strings and introduces tenant_id partitioning so multiple tenants can share the same thread_id without overwriting each other.
